svg.title: TCP 3-way handshake
svg.desc: The server calls listen() and is in the LISTEN state, then calls accept(). The client calls connect() and enters SYN_SENT, sending SYN M to the server. The server enters SYN_RECV and replies SYN N, ACK M+1. connect() returns on the client, which is now ESTABLISHED. The client sends ACK N+1, and this ACK segment can include data. accept() returns on the server, which is now ESTABLISHED.

g.text: <STATE> = state of the TCP state machine
